why: A report whose only body is a heading "Resolved, That the proceedings ... exempted" lost its single line to the leading-title skip; a Resolved line is the body, not a title.
title: Exempted Business
html: [(proc text) Resolved, "That the proceedings on the business set down on the Order Paper for today be exempted at today's Sitting from the provisions of Standing Order No 2." – [Ms Indranee Rajah] (proc text)]
